# Christopher Portfolio

I build mechanical and electronic projects, then document the tests, revisions, and open problems.

## Primary Pages

- [Portfolio homepage](https://chrisaheskett.vercel.app/)

## Main Projects

- Garden Party Pinball: A full-size homebrew pinball machine in progress using FAST boards, Mission Pinball Framework, coils, switches, lamps, cabinet wiring, and playfield revisions. Media: 2 slots, 0 live, 2 placeholders.
- VividGrasp AI-Vision Robotics Arm: Stanford AI4ALL project built by a team of 10 students. It connects SolidWorks CAD, STL mesh export, URDF/PyBullet simulation, target-based vision/control input, and robotic arm joint motion. Role: Head CAD designer, prepared URDF files, worked with a teammate to create a physical prototype. ([source](https://github.com/LenekyRadish/VividGrasp)). Media: 4 slots, 4 live, 0 placeholders.
- Smart Self-Watering Pot / Smart Planter PCB: A plant-watering prototype with moisture sensing, pump control, electronics packaging, and enclosure/PCB work. It still needs updated photos, schematics, and test notes. Media: 2 slots, 0 live, 2 placeholders.
- Subpix: Open-source Electron, Vite, React, and TypeScript desktop app for editing .subpix files, validating JSON load/save data, exporting PNGs, and packaging for Windows. Role: Built the editor, file format flow, export path, product site, and Windows packaging. ([project](https://subpix-editor.vercel.app/), [source](https://github.com/Chrissyuh/Subpix)). Media: 2 slots, 0 live, 2 placeholders.

## B-Level Projects

- Check-ins: Live web app for logging check-ins and tracking target gaps, max gaps, and progress. ([project](https://check-ins-zeta.vercel.app/)). Media: 1 slot, 0 live, 1 placeholder.

## C-Level Projects

- MIDI Practice Tool: Python practice tool for soundfonts, pedals, controls, and keyboard-style interaction. Media: 1 slot, 0 live, 1 placeholder.
- Desmos 3D Solar System: 3D math visualization using surfaces, orbits, color mapping, and performance tradeoffs. ([project](https://www.desmos.com/3d/qcjp33t4ij)). Media: 1 slot, 0 live, 1 placeholder.
- TinyGPT Experiments: Learning project on small next-token models and how pretraining differs from instruction following. Media: 1 slot, 0 live, 1 placeholder.
- VEX V5 Drivetrain Prototype: Robot drivetrain prototype built around gearing, packaging, shafts, and structure clearance. Media: 1 slot, 0 live, 1 placeholder.
